summary: Variables can be defined in inventory, playbooks, reusable files, roles and the command line; Ansible loads them all and picks one by precedence.
questions: If a variable is defined in several places, which one does Ansible use?

answer_card.title: Where variables can be set
answer_card.answer_md: Inventory, playbooks, reusable files, roles and the command line. Ansible loads all of them and picks the value according to **variable precedence**.
